sources.title: Introducing Widget-1
sources.text: Today we are releasing Widget-1, our newest model. Widget-1 scores 87.5% on the Example benchmark, up from 80.1% for Widget-0. It is available today via API at $2 per million input tokens. Widget-1 can call external tools and operate multi-step agent workflows.

sources.title: ExampleAI launches Widget-1
sources.text: ExampleAI on Monday launched Widget-1. According to the company, Widget-1 scores 87.5% on the Example benchmark. Analysts said pricing of $2 per million input tokens undercuts rivals.
